acceptanceCriteria: A profile names the git subprocess call sites that dominate the doccorpus tests
Shared fixtures or batched git reads cut the package's wall time; a before/after at stated load is retained
body: Measured by the tests-reliability lane (2026-10-21, V1-1001): the doccorpus package hit a 9m bound with 165 of 179 tests done at load 14-24. The cost is git subprocesses spawned through internal/contextindex. The lane could not fix it, because internal/contextindex was outside its paths. Details are in docs/build-log/2026-10-20-tests-reliability-batch.md once batch 1021c+ lands.

completion.reason: Delivered on main ef2a01db52d5436c262725d136060c9eb95e8580 via batch beamfall/corvint#1464 (lane #1461); CI green on that commit (runs 39675360530,39677108995). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 d884577d5a8c4b506149ae182fbc160f391405ac96ee11b76c6956ddf375dc3a.

title: doccorpus tests take about 10 minutes at load 20, dominated by git subprocesses in internal/contextindex
